Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)
Type: Cyberarm
Install: Clinic
Humanity Loss: 7 (2d6)
Option Slots: uses 2

Paired Cyberhands. Requires paired Cyberarms and 2 Cyberarm Option Slots on each arm. They install together and count as one item for Cost and Humanity Loss, but not for Critical Injuries or repair. Before the user's first Brawling or Martial Arts attack in a Round, outside a Grapple, they may make a Blazing Fury attack instead: one Brawling or Martial Arts check at -4 against the target's Evasion. On a hit, roll the usual Brawling or Martial Arts damage, halve it rounding up, then multiply it by how much the check beat the target's Evasion by, up to half the user's level in that skill, rounding up. On a miss, the user must spend an Action on their next turn recovering before doing anything else. A Blazing Fury attack counts as two Brawling or Martial Arts hits for Martial Arts Special Move prerequisites.

Foundry notes:

  • One item for the pair, as Corgo prices and installs them together. Its size is the 2 slots it takes in one arm; it needs 2 in each.
  • The Blazing Fury damage multiplier is rolled by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).
